description: Low-frequency wavetable oscillator, playing one short recorded cycle over and over at modulation rates

params.text: Switches the output between -5V to 5V and 0-10V; the swing from peak to peak is 10V either way
Turns the output upside down, keeping it inside the same voltage range
Sets the rate, from one cycle every four minutes to about 1000Hz; with a clock patched it multiplies the clock rate instead, at 1x in the middle of its travel
Picks which wave of the table is played, crossfading between the two nearest waves at settings in between
Scales the FM input from -100% to 100%, so the modulation can be made shallow or reversed
Scales the POS input from -100% to 100%, so the modulation can be made shallow or reversed

inputs.text: Adds to the rate by an amount set by the FM knob
A rising edge restarts the phase of the wave
Moves the position in the wavetable by an amount set by the POS knob
A clock patched here sets the rate, which the FREQ knob then multiplies or divides; the phase is left alone

outputs.text: The output, one wave of the table or a blend of two neighbouring waves

notes: it comes up with a table built into the module — four waves of 1024 points each: sine, triangle, sawtooth and square — so it makes sound before any file is loaded
menu: Initialize wavetable — throws away the loaded table and puts back the built-in sine, triangle, sawtooth and square
Load wavetable — reads a WAV, AIFF or raw sample file and plays it as the table
Save wavetable — writes the loaded table out as a 16-bit mono WAV file
Wave points — sets how many samples make up one wave of the table, from 32 up to 16384; set it to the cycle length of the file you loaded, and lower it if the display shows more than one cycle

inputs.3: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
